𝔗₁.issue: Definition body is shown but the English only paraphrases the docstring; it never states what the set is: tiles p in ℭ₁(k,n,j) with 𝓘 p ≠ 𝓘 u and smul 2 p ≤ smul 1 u. The standing assumptions ('the tile structure with the default parameters') are also left vague.

ℭ₆.issue: Definition body is shown but the English only paraphrases the docstring; it omits the defining condition {p ∈ ℭ₅(k,n,j) | ¬ (𝓘 p ⊆ G')}.

URel.issue: Definition body is shown but the English only paraphrases the docstring; it omits the defining formula u = u' ∨ ∃ p ∈ 𝔗₁(k,n,j,u), smul 10 p ≤ smul 1 u'. The docstring's claim that it is an equivalence relation on 𝔘₂ is given as a property of the definition, not as what the definition is.
